title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 03/2016
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, mics set-up on the SBD platform, recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Stunning audience tape of 9/17/82 captures a high‑energy set featuring Bertha, High Time, Touch of Grey and a soaring Goin’ Down the Road Feeling Bad > Morning Dew, with crystal‑clear sound.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate this recording five stars, praising its “off‑the‑charts” audio despite being an audience source. The show is described as rock solid from start to finish, highlighted by powerful performances of Bertha, High Time, Touch of Grey and the seamless GDTRFB > Morning Dew transition. Overall it delivers exceptional musical energy together with surprisingly pristine tape quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high 5‑star ratings, enthusiastic language about both performance and sound; no criticisms noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape praised as crystal‑clear and “off the charts,” with strong presence that puts listeners in the venue; no dropouts or muffling mentioned.

standout_songs: Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad > Morning Dew
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth set flow with a particularly powerful GDTRFB > Morning Dew segue; overall tight and engaging performance.
